intersections.note: Clinton east of John (offset one street width south of the west half, runs ENE)
Betts east of John (offset, runs ENE)
Laurel east of John (offset, runs ENE)
Hopkins east of John (offset, runs ENE)

ends.note: Wise Alley runs east from Cutter and dead-ends at the rear lot lines about 2/3 of the way to John; it does not reach John

notes: North is up; the scan is turned about 1 deg (east-west streets rise slightly to the right, Cutter's block line drifts from x~322 at Armory to ~381 at Hopkins). Only Cutter's east side is on the sheet; Cutter centre taken 25 ft (~87 px) west of the local east block line (agrees with the first water pipe minus ~7 px). John (50 ft) runs NNW-SSE across the sheet, centreline about x = 1635 + 0.294*(y-377). East of John the street grid is turned ~16 deg: Clinton, Betts, Laurel and Hopkins east of John are offset south from their west halves (by about one street width for Clinton and Betts, ~40 ft for Laurel, ~30 ft for Hopkins), so each is recorded as two T's on John. Armory is straight across John (cross). Clinton Ct. printed 'CLINTON CT.' with 24' at its south end. Scott Alley printed 'ALLEY' (north half) and 'SCOTT' (south half) plus a small 'SCOTT ALLEY' tag; 20' printed at both ends (block lines measure ~18 ft). Smith Alley printed 'ALLEY' / 'SMITH'. Stephenson Alley ends at Scott Alley (lots east of it). Block 2 (Armory-Clinton east of John): Bard is printed only between Sholl Alley and Clinton, but the same 10 ft alley runs straight north to Armory between lots 435 and 433, so the Armory T is recorded as Bard; Sholl Alley (printed 'SHOLL 2 ALLEY') runs Bard to Gamble. Gamble (10') runs from Armory straight across Clinton; south of Clinton the same alley (water pipe continuous) is printed only 'ALLEY' and runs to Betts, so it is recorded as Gamble. Neal Alley (printed 'NEAL ... ALLEY 4') runs from John ENE to Gamble; the unnamed 10 ft alley ('ALLEY') runs from Clinton SSE and ends at Neal Alley. Short dead-end courts east of Gamble (R.1429 Central Av. at y~1080, R.1403 Central at y~1880) do not reach Central and are not recorded. Central Av. (60') runs NNW-SSE at the right; only Armory, W. 15th, Clinton and Betts meet it, all as T's. W. 15th printed 'W. 15TH' 40'. Laurel east of John is drawn only to x~2840 (sheet 63 beyond). Wise Alley does not reach John.
